sourceNotes: 新增 Magpie 本机数据接入，检测到安装后默认读取其账户额度、Token 与费用
清理新增逐项审阅与保留项目
开发者清理新增 pip、VS Code、Cursor 缓存与 Xcode 归档，默认不勾选
清理功能默认开启，保留已有的关闭设置，磁盘页新增“清理空间”入口
优化清理双列卡片与项目产物审阅，开发者缓存按容量排序，保留运行中与异常提示，仅折叠无需清理的项目
增强卸载残留识别与共用数据保护
AI 额度标签与菜单栏统一使用服务图标，优化账户切换和额度间距，移除弹窗内重复的刷新按钮
修复开发工具缓存预览失败、预览与执行路径不一致及重复计量的问题
移除 Sub2API 额度接入与相关设置，升级时清除旧接入凭据

en: Add local Magpie integration: when installed, use its account quotas, tokens and costs by default, including Grok and other supported services; switch between providers and view each account separately with quota progress bars. Token usage includes only requests routed through Magpie and costs are shown in USD; without Magpie, continue using local Codex / Claude Code data
Add item-by-item cleanup review and retained paths; deselect individual folders and recheck retained directories, running apps and path safety before cleaning
Add pip, VS Code and Cursor caches and Xcode archives to developer cleanup, unselected by default; preserve editor settings and sessions and move confirmed Xcode archives to Trash
Enable cleanup by default while preserving existing disabled settings and add a Clean Up Space entry on the disk page; scan only when opening cleanup and require confirmation before cleaning

Improve cleanup cards and project-artifact review, sort developer caches by size, keep running-app and error warnings visible, collapse only items needing no cleanup and keep Trash preferences, retained paths and logs at the bottom

Improve app-leftover detection and shared-data protection; preserve shared data when other installed copies exist or installation locations cannot be fully checked, and retry only remaining items from the original list
Use consistent provider icons in quota tabs and the menu bar, improve account transitions and quota spacing and remove the duplicate refresh button in the popover

Fix developer-cache preview failures, inconsistent preview and execution paths and double counting; show no cleanup needed for Homebrew zero-byte maintenance items and prevent requested retained items from being cleaned when the retained-path limit is reached
Remove Sub2API quota integration and settings and clear its old credentials on upgrade; use Magpie or the corresponding CLI local accounts for subscription quotas
